extraction.name: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge)
extraction.description: The ARC dataset consists of 7,787 natural, grade-school science questions authored for standardized human tests, partitioned into a Challenge Set (2,590 questions answered incorrectly by both retrieval and co-occurrence baselines) and an Easy Set (5,197 questions). It is accompanied by the ARC Corpus containing 14M science-related sentences mined from the Web.
extraction.creator: Peter Clark, Isaac Cowhey, Oren Etzioni, Tushar Khot, Ashish Sabharwal, Carissa Schoenick, Oyvind Tafjord
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The question dataset was assembled through several months of extensive search and investigation, collecting public-domain and partner standardized test questions from US state assessment programs, national exams, and international assessments. The accompanying ARC Corpus was gathered by running search queries constructed from 100 hand-written templates across 80 US elementary and middle school science topics, collecting top documents, and augmenting with the AristoMini corpus.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Standardized tests from various educational boards and organizations (e.g., ACTAAP, MCAS, NY Regents, TIMSS, NAEP, and an anonymous content partner named Mercury), and Web documents mined using a major search engine along with AristoMini.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Questions were filtered into non-diagram multiple-choice format and partitioned into Challenge and Easy sets based on whether both an Information Retrieval (IR) solver and a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) solver answered them incorrectly. For the ARC Corpus, top retrieved documents were de-duplicated, stripped down to capture plain text, chunked into sentences, and merged with AristoMini.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Questions and their ground truth answers were authored by examiners for standardized human tests rather than annotated post-hoc.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: ARC questions are restricted to non-diagram, multiple-choice questions. Defining Challenge questions via failures of two baseline algorithms only approximates the informal goal of being 'hard'. For the ARC Corpus, approximately 75% of collected documents were judged science-relevant, and 11 question words do not appear in the corpus.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: AI research in advanced question answering, complex reasoning, and reading comprehension; partitioned into Train, Dev, and Test sets.
